'''Prnthik''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a stims vendor on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
